title: CAMC for the Air Conditioner units installed at Chennai Lighthouse & Museum under Chennai Directorate- Reg.
summary: Sealed quotations for a one-year comprehensive annual maintenance contract for eight air conditioner units in the inspection quarters and ground floor museum at Chennai Lighthouse.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Chennai Lighthouse & Museum
sites.work: CAMC of air conditioner units in inspection quarters and museum

scope.item: CAMC - 1st Floor, I.Q., Hall, Voltas make, 1.5 Ton Split A/C
CAMC - 1st Floor, I.Q., Bed Room, Blue Star make, 1.5 Ton Inverter A/C
CAMC - 2nd Floor, I.Q., Hall, Blue Star make, 1.5 Ton Inverter A/C
CAMC - 2nd Floor, I.Q., Bed Room, Hitachi make, 1.5 Ton Split A/C
CAMC - 2nd Floor, I.Q., Mini Bed Room, Voltas make, 1.5 Ton Split A/C
CAMC - Ground Floor Museum, Voltas make 2 Ton Cassette A/C

money.notes: No estimated cost or EMD printed. Payment quarterly (25% of order value) after successful completion of quarterly services; bills to Navigational Assistant Grade-1, Chennai Lighthouse. Rates inclusive of labour, materials, T&P, transport.

period.completion: One year CAMC from work order, renewable for a further 2 years on annual basis subject to performance

eligibility: Reputed firms or authorized dealer or agent
specs: Monthly maintenance service in first week of every month
CAMC covers replacement of all parts except condensing coil, compressor and AC enclosure; includes gas recharging and troubleshooting
Breakdown calls to be attended immediately; service reports to be submitted
Makes: Voltas, Blue Star, Hitachi (existing units)

documents.file: CAMC of AC at Chennai Lighthouse_0.pdf

notes: NIQ dated 30/05/2024; sealed quotations to reach office by 10.06.2024 15:00. Quantity of AC units may increase/decrease at authority's discretion. Bidders may visit site. Office contact printed is a gmail address on the directorate letterhead.
